newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Giribaldi raises CIR stake to 13.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Giribaldi raises CIR stake to 13.2 pct.

text.p: Italian financier Luigi Giribaldi has raised his stake in industrial holding company CIR to 13.2 percent from 11.7 percent, La Repubblica newspaper reported on Sunday.
Giribaldi also has a stake of 20 percent in Cofide, the family holding company of Carlo De Benedetti, the newspaper added.
Cofide holds just over 50 percent of CIR, which in turn is still the single largest shareholder in information and technology group Olivetti with a stake of 9.3 percent.
CIR's stake in Olivetti has been reduced since June 1996, when it stood at 14.5 percent. De Benedetti in September 1996 stood down as chairman of Olivetti and is now honorary president of the group.
